answer: Before dawn the cooper taps the first stave of the day, listening for the ring that says the oak is sound. Keg hoop riveter barrel charter is the listening: a charter hoop riveters file after riveting bench inspections. First comes the garden, tapped while the yard is still dark; then the beacon, tapped as the light comes up; the hollow is the stave itself, straight-grained and true. A cheat must tap 17 false staves and fake 17 false rings.
